# Security Policy

Filament Form Builder accepts input from anonymous visitors and stores it, so please report anything that lets a submission do more than fill in a form: bypassing validation, the spam checks or a form's availability window, reading another form's submissions, or reaching the panel without the right ability.

If you discover a security issue, email [support@packstub.dev](mailto:support@packstub.dev) instead of using the issue tracker. We answer within a few days and credit reporters in the changelog unless they prefer otherwise.
